sources.title: real-nepali-kala: open audio or speech model | AxForge
sources.snippet: real-nepali-kala is an open-weight audio or speech model from ampixa. real-nepali-v0.2-kala (BF16) weighs 935 MB; the smallest configuration that runs it is RTX 3060 12 GB. real-nepali-kala is a multi-speaker text-to-speech model for the Nepali language, developed by ampixa.
